speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry intends to delink the eligibility criteria of childcare subsidies from the mother's employment status and, if no, what is the rationale keeping employment status as a criterion.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: So, I urge the Member to wait another day or two.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
text: Could I just ask, especially given that we are celebrating women this month, is there a reason why we only specify and link this eligibility criterion to the mother's employment, and not the father's?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And the way to encourage them to return to the labour market, if they wish; and if they do, then, they can be assured that childcare will be supported.
